causal_features.bar_availability: All price, flow and volume inputs use the completed signal bar or earlier.
causal_features.common_factor: For each target and bar, the median contemporaneous return of the other three completed bars.
causal_features.entry: First open after the completed five-minute signal bar.
causal_features.flow: True target taker-buy quote from official kline fields, aggregated causally over completed bars.
causal_features.later_period_prohibition: No development ranking, threshold or family decision may use 2024 or 2025 values.
causal_features.normalization: Rolling means and standard deviations are shifted one bar; the current observation is never in its own normalization history.
causal_features.residual: Target completed-bar return minus prior-estimated beta times the current completed leave-one-out factor return.
causal_features.rolling_beta: Target-versus-leave-one-out-factor covariance divided by factor variance, estimated only from bars strictly before the signal bar.

dataset.source: official Binance Vision monthly USD-M archives, adjacent CHECKSUM verified by the reused snapshot

development_gate.diversity_before_rank: Preserve at least one representative per passing family before filling by robust score.

economic_hypothesis: BTC, ETH, SOL and XRP share a time-varying crypto factor, but temporary asset-specific inventory, information and liquidity shocks create residual moves. Residuals unsupported by target taker flow should mean-revert; residuals supported by target flow and a dispersion expansion should continue. A separate compression-to-dispersion arm tests whether unusually low cross-sectional dispersion followed by a factor-neutral breakout predicts continuation, while a low-efficiency high-flow residual tests absorption reversal.

execution.funding: not available in this reused snapshot; this is a rejection screen and is never Champion-eligible
execution.horizon_exit: first eligible open after the fixed hold
execution.stop: signal-bar ATR multiple from actual entry; entry-bar and gap stops included

families.dispersion_absorption: Trade opposite an extreme residual when aggressive target flow is large but residual path efficiency is low.
families.dispersion_breakout: After prior cross-sectional compression, trade the largest factor-neutral residual in its direction when dispersion and flow expand.
families.residual_flow_continuation: Trade with an extreme residual when target taker flow and activity confirm the move.
families.residual_mean_reversion: Trade opposite an extreme cumulative residual when target flow does not confirm the residual move.

non_overlap.distinguishing_feature: Every target uses a leave-one-out median factor of the other three assets and a causally estimated rolling beta; no asset is permanently designated leader or follower.
excluded_scopes: fixed BTC/ETH or four-asset leader-lagger thresholds
candlestick, engulfing and first-touch pattern families

objective: Test whether dynamic four-asset common-factor residual states contain cost-robust single-leg alpha that is not captured by fixed leader-lagger rules.
prohibitions: No target-return, leverage or risk fitting.
No 2024 access before the frozen development gate and representative manifest.
No 2025 access before a single frozen selection primary.
No paper, testnet or live orders.
No Champion proposal from this screen because actual funding and order-book execution are absent.
ranking: descending minimum of H1 return, H2 return, 18bp return and 24bp return

time_splits.confirmation_open_rule: Only a single frozen 2024 primary may open 2025.
time_splits.selection_open_rule: Only frozen development representatives may open 2024.
